reauth_confirm.title: Link Autodarts again
reauth_confirm.description: Link your account with the new Autodarts device login. Enter a public client ID registered for this integration with device authorization enabled. Your board, entities and local settings will be kept.

data_description.client_id: Public OAuth client ID with device authorization, issued by Autodarts for this integration.

auth_retry.title: Restart Autodarts login
auth_retry.description: Submit to return to the client settings and request a new login code.

boards.title: Load Autodarts boards
boards.description: Your account is linked. Submit to retry loading your boards.

board.title: Select Board
board.description: Choose the Autodarts board to monitor.

cloud.title: Set up Autodarts
cloud.description: Enter the public client ID registered with Autodarts for this integration, with device authorization enabled. This is an application ID, not your email, board ID or a secret. Optionally enter your local board IP. The next screen will show your login code.

data_description.client_id: Public OAuth client ID with device authorization, issued by Autodarts for this integration. Not your e-mail address, password or board ID.
data_description.host: Optional. Also connects the board locally, which enables controls and realtime events.

user.title: Set up Autodarts
user.description: Search your network for Autodarts boards, enter a board address, or link your Autodarts account for match data.

menu_options.discover: Search for boards on this network

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Autodarts
reconfigure.description: Change the local board address or add cloud login. Your existing board and entities are retained.

menu_options.discover: Search for boards on this network

local.title: Connect local board
local.description: Enter the Board Manager IP address or hostname, without http:// or a port. No client ID is required. The board must already be configured in Board Manager.

data_description.host: IP address or host name of the PC running Autodarts Board Manager, for example 192.168.1.50. Without http:// and without a port.

discover.title: Choose your board
discover.description: Autodarts listed these boards for your network. The lookup uses the same service as the Board Manager app and sees your public IP address. The board is then connected locally, without an Autodarts login.

data_description.board_id: Boards that are already set up are not listed.

zeroconf_confirm.title: Autodarts board found
zeroconf_confirm.description: Add the Autodarts board at {host}? Board Manager {version}, {cameras} cameras. It works locally, without an Autodarts login.

progress.wait_for_device:
Open [Autodarts login]({verification_uri_complete}) and approve the connection. Alternatively, open [{verification_uri}]({verification_uri}) on another device and enter **{user_code}**.

This screen continues automatically after approval. Only share this code with your own Autodarts login.

error.invalid_client: This client ID is invalid or is not enabled for device login. Check the client ID for this integration. Local board setup is available without a client ID.
error.expired_token: The login code expired. Please request a new code.
error.access_denied: The connection was denied. Please restart login and approve it.
error.invalid_auth: Autodarts could not authorize this connection. Please link your account again.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to Autodarts. Please try again.
error.invalid_host: Enter an IP address or hostname only.
error.cannot_connect_local: Cannot reach the local Board Manager or its response is invalid.
error.board_not_configured: No board ID is configured in Board Manager. Complete board setup there first.
error.no_boards_found: No new boards were found automatically. Enter the board address instead.
error.discovery_failed: The board search is unavailable right now. Enter the board address instead.

abort.already_configured: This Autodarts board is already configured.
abort.no_boards: No boards found for this account.
abort.wrong_account: The linked account does not have access to the existing board. Please link the account that owns this board.
abort.reauth_successful: Autodarts was linked successfully. Your board and entities have been kept.
abort.wrong_board: This address belongs to a different board.
abort.cannot_connect_local: The board announced on your network does not answer. Check that Board Manager is running.
abort.board_not_configured: No board ID is configured in Board Manager. Complete board setup there first.
abort.already_in_progress: Setup of this board is already in progress.

action_failed.message: The board did not accept the action. Check the connection to Board Manager and try again.

wrong_board.message: The configured address belongs to a different board.

no_local_address.message: Configure the local Board Manager address.

relink_required.message: Link your Autodarts account again with a registered client ID.

cloud_unavailable.message: The Autodarts cloud does not answer.

wrong_board.title: Autodarts board address points to a different board
wrong_board.description: The board at {address} has a different board ID than the one this entry belongs to, so it stays offline. Open the Autodarts integration, choose **Reconfigure** and select the correct board.

board_manager_1.title: Update the board to the new Autodarts Board Manager
board_manager_1.description: This board runs the classic Board Manager app. Autodarts replaces it with the headless Board Manager 2 and will turn the old one off once most players have migrated. Install Board Manager 2 on the board PC; the integration switches over automatically and keeps working locally.
